games.headline: Brandon Miller scores career-high 39 points as Hornets beat Wizards 110-103
games.desc: — Brandon Miller scored a career-high 39 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Washington Wizards 110-103 on Monday night for their third win in four games to open the season.

games.headline: Mitchell scores 26 as Cavaliers rally and defeat Timberwolves 127-125 in overtime
games.desc: — Donovan Mitchell had 26 points, including five points in overtime, and the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 despite 47 points from Anthony Edwards.

games.headline: Pritchard scores 28 points and has red-hot 3rd quarter to carry Celtics to 134-99 rout over Bulls
games.desc: — Payton Pritchard made all five of his 3-point attempts during Boston’s big third quarter and finished with 28 points, to lead the Celtics to a 134-99 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Monday night.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg dominates with 29 points, Dallas adds to winless Miami's misery with 113-109 victory
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg had 29 points and 11 assists, plus blocked a shot that would have given Miami the lead in the final moments, and the Dallas Mavericks sent the reeling Heat to 0-4 with a 113-109 win on Monday night.

games.headline: Herro has 23 points and 10 rebounds as the Bucks beat the Pacers 110-102 for first win of the season
games.desc: — Tyler Herro had 23 points, 10 rebounds and seven assists as the Milwaukee Bucks defeated the Indiana Pacers 110-102 on Monday night for their first win of the season.

games.headline: Ajay Mitchell, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander lead injury-riddled Thunder past Suns 125-114
games.desc: — Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 30 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 and the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Phoenix Suns 125-114 on Monday night.

games.headline: Sengun has 29 points as Rockets stay unbeaten with 120-110 win over Hawks
games.desc: — Alperen Sengun had 29 points, nine assists and nine rebounds and the Houston Rockets remained unbeaten with a 120-110 win over the Atlanta Hawks Monday night.

games.headline: Grizzlies outlast Jazz for second win in four games over Utah
games.desc: — Cedric Coward tallied 16 points and 11 rebounds to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 110-105 victory over the Utah Jazz on Monday night — their second in four games over Utah.

games.headline: Lendeborg has 31 points, 12 rebounds as Warriors earn 1st win of season by beating Nuggets 134-114
games.desc: — Yaxel Lendeborg had 31 points and 12 rebounds as the Golden State Warriors beat the Denver Nuggets 134-114 on Monday night for their first win of the season.
